study: Garet et al. 2011, Middle School Mathematics PD Impact Study (NCEE 2011-4024)
delivery_evidence: PD delivered as a summer institute, one-day follow-up seminars during the school year, and in-school coaching visits; all face-to-face (ch.2 'Summer Institute and Seminar Series' / 'Coaching', pp.22-23).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is a customized, computer-adaptive NWEA Rational Number Test drawn from a custom item bank narrowly targeting the rational-number content the PD taught (proximal); Table B-1, Appendix B; described p.~? 'A customized, computer-adaptive rational number test'.
curriculum_evidence: PD targeted teachers' knowledge of rational-number content and instruction; no new student curriculum was adopted—teachers continued their existing curriculum (PD providers selected on existing rational-numbers PD materials; control = business-as-usual).
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted effect sizes are the spring Y2 (end of second/final year of implementation) wave, i.e., end of intervention (Table 3-4 End of Second Year panel; Table 4-3).
